name: Large trades
summary: Every 10 minutes, list trades of $1,000 or more in the markets you follow.
description:
Big trades show where people with conviction, or information, put their money.

This workflow searches for bitcoin markets, reads their trades from the last 10 minutes, and keeps those worth $1,000 or more. Each trade appears once, however many runs see it.

- Change the words in Search markets to follow other markets.
- Change the Value in $1,000 or more to raise or lower the bar.
- Each trade item names the wallet that made it: paste one into the Wallets page to follow what it holds with Your positions.

nodes.notes: Runs every 10 minutes while the workflow is active.

nodes.name: Markets to follow
nodes.notes: The markets to watch: open ones with bitcoin in their title.
Reads each market's trades from the last 10 minutes. Adds value: price times size, in dollars.
A trade has a unique transaction hash. Passes each one once.
